editorial:
Imagine finding out your perfect husband had a secret wife who looks exactly like you. That is the nightmare Jenna wakes up to in this tense thriller. You will feel the panic as she digs into her husband's past and finds out he has a very scary habit of picking the same type of woman over and over. The vibe is super creepy, and it makes you wonder if you can ever really know the person sleeping next to you. It starts as a mystery but quickly turns into a race for survival as Jenna realizes she might just be a replacement part in a sick game.

The acting is great and the twists keep you guessing until the very end. While some parts move a bit slow in the middle, the big reveals make up for it. If you love stories about secret lives and crazy obsession, you need to see this. You should definitely stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best picture, or you can rent it on Apple TV for a movie night. If you are a collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a smart move so you can rewatch those clues.
endingExplained: In the end, you discover the husband actually killed his first wife because she tried to leave him. He didn't just love the look; he wanted total control. Jenna finds the hidden body in the basement just as he tries to trap her. After a wild fight, Jenna manages to knock him out and call the police. He gets arrested, and Jenna finally escapes the house, realizing she was almost the next body in the ground.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological thrillers and twisty mysteries.
